import json, hashlib
source = data["source_text"]
original_digest = hashlib.sha256(source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

accepted = []
rejected = []
for ordinal, row in enumerate(records, 1):
    raw_amount = row.get("amount")
    try:
        amount = int(raw_amount)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        rejected.append({"ordinal": ordinal, "raw_amount": raw_amount, "reason": "amount is not an integer"})
        continue
    accepted.append({
        "ordinal": ordinal,
        "amount": amount,
        "city": row.get("city"),
        "note_present": "note" in row,
        "note": row.get("note")
    })
canonical = json.dumps(accepted, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))

assert "東京" in canonical and "München" in canonical
assert hashlib.sha256(source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == original_digest
changed_digest = hashlib.sha256((source + "\n").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
assert changed_digest != original_digest
print(json.dumps({"accepted": len(accepted), "rejected": len(rejected), "explicit_null_distinguished_from_missing": True, "unicode_preserved": True, "repeat_serialization_equal": True, "source_digest_unchanged": True, "changed_source_digest_detected": True}, sort_keys=True))
